data.display_address: District One Villas, District One, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience refined luxury living in this exceptional 4-bedroom villa located in the prestigious District One Villas community. Set on a generous 7,665 sq. ft. plot with a built-up area of 6,393 sq. ft., this beautifully designed residence offers spacious interiors, elegant finishes, and a peaceful park-backing location.

Ready to move in and situated in the highly sought-after Phase 1, the villa is within walking distance to the clubhouse and crystal lagoon, offering residents an exclusive resort-style lifestyle. The home features expansive living and dining areas, a separate fully equipped kitchen, generously sized en-suite bedrooms, and dedicated maid’s and driver’s rooms for added convenience.

The beautifully landscaped garden provides the perfect setting for outdoor entertaining and family gatherings, while the thoughtfully designed layout ensures both privacy and comfort.

Property Features:
• 4 Spacious Bedrooms
• 5 Bathrooms
• BUA: 6,393 sq. ft.
• Plot Size: 7,665 sq. ft.
• Ready To Move In
• Park Backing Location
• Prime Phase 1 Community
• Walking Distance to Clubhouse & Lagoon
• Maids Room
• Drivers Room
• Separate Fully Equipped Kitchen
• Laundry Room
• Beautifully Landscaped Garden

An ideal choice for families seeking luxury, space, and a premium lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most exclusive communities.
